config.name: Audited Production Runtime Spec (V=512, d=128, L=4)

discrepancies.original_claim: Phase 2 evaluated (V=4096, d=256, d_ff=512, d_e=128, d_v=64) while Phase 4 silently switched to (V=512, d=192, d_ff=384, d_e=96, d_v=48).
discrepancies.audited_finding: Both configurations were conflated in the narrative without documenting the dimension reduction from d=256 to d=192 and V=4096 to V=512.
discrepancies.correction: All metrics are now explicitly tabulated per configuration and verified against instantiated tensors.

discrepancies.audited_finding: Exact parameter count for Phase 4 config (V=512, d=192, L=6) is 1,074,636 (discrepancy of +355,680 params).
discrepancies.root_cause: Original calculation omitted the L=6 unshared w_alpha matrices (222,336 params) and undercounted the 36 modulator matrices.
discrepancies.correction: Verified closed-form formula against model.count_parameters() = 1,074,636 (or 927,180 when w_alpha is shared).

discrepancies.audited_finding: Exact parameter count for Phase 2 config (V=4096, d=256, L=6) is 2,202,892 (~2.25M), or 1,924,364 (~1.97M) with shared w_alpha.
discrepancies.root_cause: Omitted unshared w_alpha (394,752 params) and half of the SwiGLU low-rank adapter matrices.
discrepancies.correction: Updated Table 2.4 to exact tensor sum.

discrepancies.audited_finding: Exact parameter count for BaselineTransformerLM at (V=512, d=192, L=6, max_seq_len=1024) is 2,509,248.
discrepancies.root_cause: Table 4.3 calculated parameters using V=1024 and untied embeddings instead of the actual V=512 tied model.

discrepancies.audited_finding: export_deltacore_int8 on Phase 4 config writes exactly 1,199,456 bytes (1171.34 KiB / 1.144 MB).
discrepancies.root_cause: Original estimate divided erroneous parameter count (718,956) by 1024 and ignored the 4-byte FP32 per-row scale headers and unshared w_alpha.
discrepancies.correction: Verified byte-exact exporter output: 1,199,456 bytes for d=192 L=6 and 436,560 bytes (426.33 KiB) for the deployed d=128 L=4 runtime.

discrepancies.category: Recurrent Session State Size Unit Confusion
discrepancies.audited_finding: Exact state is L=6 * (384 conv + 192 fast + 768 slow) = 8,064 floats = 32,256 bytes (31.5 KiB binary / 32.256 KB decimal).
discrepancies.root_cause: Rounding drift between KiB (1024) and KB (1000).
discrepancies.correction: Reported exact byte count (32,256 B for d=192 L=6; 14,336 B = 14.0 KiB for d=128 L=4).

discrepancies.category: Training Complexity of Parallel Scan & Delta Loop
discrepancies.original_claim: O(T log T) fast scan + chunked Delta (Table 2.4)
discrepancies.audited_finding: 1) parallel_gated_scan implemented Hillis-Steele prefix scan with O(log T) depth and O(T log T * d) work (whereas Blelloch scan does O(T d) work). 2) DeltaCoreLayer.forward_sequence actually ran a sequential Python for-loop over T steps (O(T) sequential depth), NOT a chunked algorithm.
discrepancies.correction: Implemented the Chunkwise Parallel WY-Representation Delta Rule (Bischof & Van Loan 1987; Yang et al. 2024) reducing sequential depth to O(T / B_c) and verified numerical equivalence (< 1e-6).

literature_audit.component: Sub-Space Tied Vocabulary Bottleneck (E in R^{V x d_e}, P_in, P_out)
literature_audit.citation: ALBERT: A Lite BERT for Self-supervised Learning of Language Representations (Lan et al., ICLR 2020)
literature_audit.audit_verdict: Direct adoption of factorized embedding parameterization with input/output weight tying. Not novel in isolation.

literature_audit.component: Cross-Layer Shared Core + Low-Rank Adapters (W_core z + U_l V_l^T z)
literature_audit.citation: Universal Transformer (Dehghani et al., 2019); ALBERT (Lan et al., 2020); LoRA (Hu et al., ICLR 2022)
literature_audit.audit_verdict: Combines ALBERT cross-layer parameter tying with per-layer LoRA adapters to avoid spectral collapse while keeping W_core in CPU L2 cache.

literature_audit.citation: RWKV (Peng et al., EMNLP 2023); Mamba (Gu & Dao, COLM 2024)
literature_audit.audit_verdict: Standard short causal depthwise 1D convolution preceding recurrent gating.

literature_audit.component: Diagonal Input-Dependent Gated Linear Recurrence (f_t = alpha_t f_{t-1} + (1-alpha_t) u_t)
literature_audit.citation: Were RNNs All We Needed? / MinGRU (Feng et al., 2024); Griffin / RG-LRU (De et al., 2024)
literature_audit.audit_verdict: Standard first-order diagonal gated recurrence amenable to associative parallel prefix scan.

literature_audit.component: Fast-Weight Delta Update Rule (M_t = gamma_t M_{t-1} + beta_t k_t (v_t - gamma_t M_{t-1}^T k_t)^T)
literature_audit.citation: Widrow & Hoff (1960); Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers / DeltaNet (Schlag et al., ICML 2021); Gated DeltaNet (Yang et al., NeurIPS 2024)
literature_audit.audit_verdict: Generalized Householder rank-1 erasure-and-write update rule.

literature_audit.component: Asymmetric Dual-Timescale Co-State (O(d) Fast Vector + Rectangular O(r_s x d_v) Slow Delta Matrix with L2-Pinned Core)
literature_audit.audit_verdict: Genuine systems-level contribution: offloading high-bandwidth local syntax to the O(d) diagonal scan allows compressing the Delta associative matrix key rank to r_s << d (e.g. r_s=16 vs d=192), cutting matrix state memory and FLOPs by 12x while retaining selective key-value overwriting.
